question: In a code language, 'TANYA' is coded as BUBZO and 'RAHUL' is coded as BSMVI. How will 'MOHIT' be coded in the same language?
solution:
Alphabet Table:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'TANYA' is coded as 'BUBZO'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a8769cf1176181960fb540f25f7dcf9d952b40827f15d6a69a39b4e0048fa5f.png] 

'RAHUL' is coded as 'BSMVI'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb07fb3c9b114068da5c34b5e0a729406904697fff324a0f43e5d5b6c6ed16da.png] 

SImilarly, for 'MOHIT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96e6fe01b1d73ef85333909bb494e6ccb5417db10b662dd4fc155b9a7642e771.png] 

So, 'MOHIT' will coded as 'PNUJI'.

Hence, the correct answer is "*PNUJI".*​
